title: Total Energy's Era Energi partners with Zhuochuangtong to accelerate Indonesia's energy transition -a global energy giant joins forces with a local team to develop renewable energy and power infrastructure.-health latestjobnews-Serve the health of the people, we are with public welfare
text:
2026-05-05 Era Energi, the investment platform of Total Energy, a leading global integrated energy company, announced a strategic partnership with ZhuoChuangTong, an Indonesian energy consulting firm . The two companies will integrate global technology resources with localized operational experience to jointly drive Indonesia's energy transition and help achieve its "net-zero emissions by 2060" goal. Background of the collaboration: Global experience empowers local innovation Total Energy, an energy giant operating in more than 120 countries, is committed to supporting global sustainable development through a diversified energy portfolio. This expansion into the Indonesian market through Era Energi aims to leverage the Zhuochuangtong team's deep understanding of local policies, culture, and business environment to accelerate the implementation of renewable energy projects and optimize the efficiency of traditional energy development. Zhuochuangtong's team has been deeply involved in Indonesia's energy sector for many years, successfully leading several national-level new energy projects covering solar, wind, and smart grid construction. Its localized resource network complements Total Energy's full-chain technology, laying a solid foundation for cooperation. Three core areas drive transformation Gunter Seeger, President of Total Energy Asia Pacific He stated, "Indonesia is a core market for the Asia-Pacific energy transition. This collaboration will integrate international standards with local needs, create green jobs in Indonesia, and help it become a leader in the low-carbon economy in Southeast Asia." Zhuochuangtong team leader [ Luna ] He emphasized, "We are not only technology importers, but also co-builders of Indonesia's energy future. Through our cooperation with Total Energy, we will shorten project implementation cycles and ensure that every investment truly meets the needs of the local community." Regarding the two parties involved in the cooperation TotalEnergies is
one of the world's five largest energy companies, with operations spanning the entire value chain of oil, gas, renewable energy, and electricity. It is committed to driving energy supply and climate action in parallel through innovative technologies. ZhuoChuangTong is
a leading energy consulting team in Indonesia, specializing in policy research, project development, and international capital matchmaking. It has successfully promoted the implementation of multiple national-level new energy projects and is known as "the bridge for Indonesia's energy transition".
